tagline: Egg Protein Conditioner – Deep Repair & Silky Smooth Hair
intro: Nourish and restore your hair with KB Egg Protein Conditioner, a rich conditioning formula designed to repair damage, reduce dryness, and improve hair strength. Infused with the power of egg protein, this conditioner helps rebuild weak hair strands, enhance natural shine, and promote healthier hair growth.
Specially formulated for dry and brittle hair, it deeply moisturizes, smoothens frizz, and leaves hair soft, manageable, and visibly healthier without weighing it down.

p: After shampooing, apply an adequate amount to damp hair, focusing on mid-lengths and ends. Leave on for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.
Perfect for achieving smooth, shiny, and healthier-looking hair with every wash

full: Egg Protein Conditioner – Deep Repair & Silky Smooth Hair
